properties.name: greenops.spire.trust-domain
properties.description: SPIFFE trust domain accepted by workload SVID validation.

properties.name: greenops.spire.trust-anchor-pem
properties.description: PEM encoded X.509 trust anchor for SPIFFE SVID validation.

properties.name: greenops.spire.jwt-rsa-public-key
properties.description: Base64 DER encoded RSA public key for JWT SVID verification.

properties.name: greenops.spire.jwt-audience
properties.description: Expected audience claim in JWT SVIDs.

properties.name: greenops.spire.trusted-node-attestation-hashes
properties.description: Comma separated node attestation hashes trusted by the SPIRE watcher.

properties.name: greenops.spire.baseline.allowed-binaries
properties.description: Comma separated process names allowed in the default workload baseline.

properties.name: greenops.spire.baseline.user-profiles
properties.description: Semicolon separated per-user process profiles, with binaries separated by pipes.

properties.name: greenops.deception.trusted-proxies
properties.description: Comma separated proxy IP addresses permitted to supply X-Forwarded-For.

properties.name: greenops.auth.cookie-secure
properties.description: Whether the GreenOps authentication cookie requires HTTPS.
